108 - Ambulance Services:
“108” Ambulance Service is being successfully operated in Tamil Nadu through PPP (Public Private
Partnership) mode through a single Toll Free number and the services are available 24x7 free to the public.
Every ambulance has one fully trained Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) who provides pre-hospital care to
the patient.
